reason: A is the better, though imperfect, proposal because it predicts a temperature-dependent stability limit and a falsifiable segregation onset rather than extrapolating reported stability below 1000 K across the full range. Its mechanism needs refinement—configurational entropy is thermodynamic, while diffusion controls rate and segregation direction is set by chemical potentials, surface energies, and reactions—but B more directly restates the disputed “sluggish diffusion” HEA effect and lacks evidence for stability near 1923 K.
